note: Era opinions may color free/Hard speech when labeled. They must NOT fill Hard evidence slots. Numbers belong only on FactStore cards. Cards era-op-alpha-outer-layer / incomplete-without-electrons / thick-target-suspicion / method-doubt-zns added 2026-09-07 for abstract Critic (fills_slots always false).

cards.content: Around 1909–1910, a widely taught picture (after J. J. Thomson) places many negative corpuscles in a sphere of compensating positive electricity spread through the atom's volume. Large α deflections are often expected only as the rare sum of many small encounters (compound scattering), not as a single catastrophic kick.
cards.content_zh: 约 1909–1910，主流教学图景（循 J. J. Thomson）把许多带负电的微粒放在弥散于原子体积内的正电球中。大角 α 偏转常被期待为多次小偏转的稀有叠加（compound scattering），而非单次剧烈遭遇。
cards.citation: Thomson atomic models as summarized in Rutherford, Phil. Mag. 21 (1911) §1 (historical framing); classroom name "plum pudding" is later vernacular.

cards.content: Before accepting single scattering from a concentrated charge, a cautious 1909 reader asks whether large angles could still be the tail of many weak deflections inside a diffuse atom.
cards.content_zh: 在接受「集中电荷的单次散射」之前，1909 年谨慎的读者会先问：大角是否仍可能只是弥散原子内多次弱偏转的尾部。
cards.citation: Rutherford 1911 contrast with Thomson/Crowther compound-scattering expectations (as era foil, not a fact fill).

cards.content: Even when diffuse reflection is reported, theorists may withhold a full structural verdict until angular laws and foil-thickness behaviour are clearer. Central charge is a working hypothesis, not instant dogma.
cards.content_zh: 即便已有漫反射报告，理论家仍可能暂缓完整结构判决，直到角分布与箔厚行为更清楚。中心电荷是工作假说，不是瞬间教条。

cards.content: The 1911 scattering paper speaks of a concentrated central charge; the later textbook word "nucleus" is not the paper's banner term. Era-faithful debate should prefer central charge unless modern textbook mode is explicit.
cards.content_zh: 1911 散射论文谈的是集中的中心电荷；后世教材用语「原子核」并非该文旗号。忠于时代的辩论应优先说中心电荷，除非明确进入现代教材模式。
cards.citation: Historiography note (e.g. Kragh); see FactStore for the paper's own wording.

cards.content: The famous "fifteen-inch shell against tissue paper" image is a later recollection/rhetoric, not a 1909 dark-room quotation. Allowed as labeled reminiscence, not as primary lab speech.
cards.content_zh: 著名的「十五英寸炮弹打在薄纸上」是事后回忆/修辞，不是 1909 暗室现场原话。可作标注过的回忆，不可当一手实验台词。
cards.citation: Late Rutherford recollection (often 1930s); flagged in manchester.json as interpretation.

cards.content: Memories disagree on whether Marsden or Geiger first excitedly reported particles coming back. Treat teller identity as unsettled era chatter; the 1909 paper authorship is Geiger & Marsden.
cards.content_zh: 回忆在「马斯登还是盖革先来报粒子折回」上不一致。报告者身份当作未定的时代闲谈；1909 论文署名为 Geiger & Marsden。
cards.citation: AIP Rutherford's Nuclear World notes memory conflict; Birks ed. reminiscences.

cards.content: Nagaoka's earlier Saturnian atom is an available mathematical aside in the literature; it is not the main motive story for Manchester α work and should not be oversold as Rutherford's adopted planetary model.
cards.content_zh: 长冈半太郎更早的土星型原子是文献中可提及的数学旁支；不应夸大成曼彻斯特 α 工作的主因，或写成卢瑟福「采用了」行星模型。

cards.content: A 1911-era reading can keep the sign of the central charge formally open even while preferring positive for convenience. Do not smuggle later certainty into Hard slots.
cards.content_zh: 1911 年的读法可以在为方便假定为正的同时，形式上保留中心电荷符号未决。勿把后世定论偷运进 Hard 证据槽。
cards.citation: Aligned to Rutherford 1911 remarks; FactStore holds the paper claim.

cards.claim: α particles leave (or scatter from) the atom's outer layers, so large-angle events need not imply a concentrated central charge.
cards.content: A cautious radiochemical stance c. 1910–1913 can place α emission or reflection in the atom's outer layers rather than a tiny centre. Large-angle scintillations then need not force a concentrated central-charge picture. (Optional named skin later: Fajans-style reservation; keep Critic abstract by default.)
cards.content_zh: 约 1910–1913 的审慎放射化学立场，可将 α 放出或反射置于原子外层，而非极小中心。大角闪烁不必立刻逼出集中中心电荷图景。（可选具名皮肤：Fajans 式保留；默认保持抽象 Critic。）
cards.citation: Historiography: Kasimir Fajans initially resisted Rutherford's nuclear atom and argued α from outer layers; withdrew reservations after Bohr 1913 (letter 13 Dec 1913). Kragh, arXiv:1112.2339; Kragh, arXiv:1202.0954 §5. Critic uses stance, not forced personal name.

cards.claim: A concentrated central-charge hypothesis that barely addresses electron arrangement or chemistry is not yet a full atomic theory.
cards.content: Even granting a concentrated central charge for scattering, a 1911-era peer may refuse to treat it as a finished atomic constitution: the 1911 scattering paper says little about electronic architecture or chemical behaviour. Explaining rare large angles is not the same as a complete atom model.
cards.content_zh: 即便承认集中中心电荷可解释散射，1911 年的同行仍可不把它当作完整原子结构论：该散射论文对电子排布与化学行为着墨甚少。解释稀有大角 ≠ 完整原子模型。
cards.citation: Historiography (Kragh et al.): Rutherford 1911 received as incomplete scattering theory until Bohr 1913 made the nuclear atom fertile; Solvay 1911 barely engaged it.

cards.claim: If large angles appear, they may still be thick-target, surface, or impurity stories rather than volume scattering in an extremely thin foil.
cards.content: A cautious 1909 reader may grant scintillations yet suspect thick-target geometry, surface reflection, or contaminants — preferring not to infer atomic interior structure from rare large angles until foil thinness and volume-effect behaviour are secured.
cards.content_zh: 1909 年谨慎读者可承认闪烁，仍怀疑厚靶几何、表面反射或杂质——在箔极薄与体积效应行为落实之前，不愿从稀有大角推断原子内部结构。
cards.citation: Era-foil caution reconstructed for Hard Critic (not a single primary quote). Rebuttal Facts: fact-gm1909-thin-gold-layer; fact-ruth1911-gold-1-in-20000. Must NOT invent thicknesses.

cards.claim: ZnS scintillation counting and dark-room geometry may be too error-prone to establish genuine diffuse reflection.
cards.content: Method skepticism: counting faint ZnS sparks by eye, plus lead/mica/reflector geometry, can be challenged as leak, glare, or observer error. Until method credibility is granted, "diffuse reflection" need not compel a new atom picture.
cards.content_zh: 方法怀疑：肉眼计数微弱 ZnS 闪点，加之铅板/云母/反射体几何，可被质疑为漏光、眩光或观测误差。在方法可信度成立前，「漫反射」不必逼出新原子图景。
cards.citation: Era Critic foil for Hard (method caution). Rebuttal Facts: fact-gm1909-zns-method; fact-gm1909-geometry (Geiger & Marsden 1909 pp. 496–497). Do not invent count rates.
